_README: Machine-readable token-supply inventory for the V5 mixture plan.
All token counts are in BILLIONS of tokens, measured with a ~100k BPE vocabulary.
Source of truth for the dataset catalog and sizes:
published - the number appears in the dataset card or the paper that released it.
estimate  - we derived it (rows * mean-tokens-per-row, or subset fraction). Error bars in `confidence`.
confirmed - size confirmed from the V4 training run / AI4Bharat release (widget tag: conf).
derived   - NOT new unique tokens. A re-packing / re-formatting of tokens already counted
in another row. Contributes 0 to unique supply. Used for the long-context lane.
overlap_discount: fraction of this dataset's tokens that we assume are already counted in
another row of this inventory (near-duplicate across corpora). Effective unique supply is
unique_tokens_b * (1 - overlap_discount). V4-confirmed slots (D1–D4, AON, D3) are heavily
discounted against the open corpora they were drawn from so we do not double-count.
Otherwise a deliberately conservative (high) guess so we under-claim supply rather than over-claim.

datasets.name: DCLM-Baseline
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~2.6T tokens / 2.6B samples. Model-filtered CommonCrawl. MMLU/GPQA workhorse.

datasets.name: FineWeb-Edu
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~1.3T. Heavy overlap with DCLM (same CC substrate, different classifier).

datasets.name: D1 Web-Foundation (V4)
datasets.notes: V4 foundational web slot (~164B). Almost entirely overlapped by FineWeb/DCLM; kept as lived reference.

datasets.name: D2 Web-Diverse (V4)
datasets.notes: V4 diverse web slot (~627B). Lived reference for last cohort; discounted against open web supply.

datasets.name: The Stack v2
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~900B / 600M samples. Deduplicated permissive-source code. Binding constraint on the code lane.

datasets.name: CommitPack / CommitPackFT
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~4B / 4M samples. Commit message + diff pairs; FT slice is license-filtered.

datasets.name: D3 Code (V4 corpus)
datasets.notes: V4 Code slot (~199B). Lived reference; heavily overlapped with Stack v2.

datasets.name: AON (V4 corpus)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory reasoning slot anchor: ~78B confirmed. Partial overlap with open CoT/math sets.

datasets.name: OpenThoughts2
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~3B / 1.1M long reasoning traces for math and code.

datasets.name: OpenMathReasoning
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~2B / 3.2M math problems with reasoning solutions.

datasets.name: OpenR1-Math (R1-distilled)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~1.6B / 220K very long R1-distilled math traces.

datasets.name: NuminaMath
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~500M / 860K curated competition math problems.

datasets.name: peS2o
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~42B / 40M open-access scientific papers. Primary GPQA feedstock.

datasets.name: proof-pile-2
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~55B. AlgebraicStack + arXiv math + math code.

datasets.name: D4 STEM (V4)
datasets.notes: V4 STEM slot (~49B). Partial overlap with peS2o / proof-pile / math web.

datasets.name: Sangraha (verified)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory confirmed: ~64B. Trustworthy core of the Indic slot.

datasets.name: Sangraha (unverified)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory confirmed: ~24B crawled but not-yet-verified slice.

datasets.name: Sangraha (synthetic)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~162B synthetic/translated expansion. Caps the gap real Indic supply cannot fill.

datasets.name: IndicCorpV2
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~20.9B across 24 languages. Substantial re-crawl into Sangraha.

datasets.name: BPCC (parallel)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~3B. Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection — quality anchor for MT.

datasets.name: Samanantar
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~2B / 49.7M pairs. High samples, short segments.

datasets.name: ToolBench
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~80M / 120K multi-tool API dialogues.

datasets.name: Glaive function-calling v2
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~50M / 113K. High sample / low token; schema adherence.

datasets.name: ToolACE
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~60M / 110K. Self-evolving synthesis over a large API pool.

datasets.name: xLAM / APIGen
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~25M / 60K execution-verified function calls.

datasets.name: Nexus / NexusRaven
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~30M / 40K curated nested/parallel calls.

datasets.name: SWE-smith
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~120M / 26K repo-grounded trajectories.

datasets.name: Hermes function-calling
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~22M / 15K structured JSON / function-calling.

datasets.name: OpenHands rollouts
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~90M / 10K end-to-end coding-agent episodes.

datasets.name: SWE-Gym
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~150M / 2.4K. Tiny sample count, very long trajectories — where agentic TOKENS live.

datasets.name: Repo-packed code (32K+)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory lists ~60B packed sequences. ZERO new unique tokens — packing strategy over code-lane supply (debited via longctx borrows_from).

datasets.name: Book-length corpora (packed)
datasets.notes: SOTA inventory: ~40B / 400K. Natively long documents and books packed to fill the context window.
